'''Kerr''' was a [[Human/Legends|Human]] who worked for [[Marus Grayson]] during the [[Galactic Civil War/Legends|Galactic Civil War]]. He once teamed up with [[Jera]] to find a skilled [[Thief/Legends|thief]] to protect the [[Jewel of Yavin/Legends|Jewel of Yavin]] during its auction in [[Cloud City/Legends|Cloud City]].
